title: Shared Hair, Groom and Strand Asset Fabric
decision: Materialize one cross-family provider-neutral shared Hair/Groom Fabric with canonical Hair Asset and typed reconstruction, grooming, dynamics and DCC/render handoff contracts. Reuse existing geometry, DCC, routing, resource, workflow, rights, security and evidence authorities. Do not create a standalone Hair application, a geometry child authority, a new capability, a runtime provider or a donor intake in this change.
